reason: A voice input utility that transcribes speech, performs constrained cleanup with the current session model, and inserts the resulting text into the conversation composer.

summaries.zh: 通过浏览器或操作系统听写将语音转换为文字，并使用当前会话模型进行受限整理后插入对话输入框。
summaries.en: Converts speech to text through browser or OS dictation, applies constrained cleanup with the current session model, and inserts the result into the conversation composer.

capabilities: speech recognition through browser or OS dictation
sending recognized text to the current session model for transcript cleanup
inserting cleaned text into the conversation composer
storing plugin settings in browser localStorage
removing the plugin from the current profile through the official uninstall command
